app_tagline: AI-powered coffee leaf health advisor for Ethiopian farmers
scan_subtitle: Upload a photo or use your camera. Get an expert, professional report in seconds.
upload_drop_text: Drag & drop a leaf photo here
camera_permission_denied: Camera access was denied or is unavailable. Please use "Choose a file" instead.
tip_1: Photograph one leaf, filling most of the frame
tip_2: Use natural daylight, avoid harsh shadows
tip_3: Keep the leaf flat and in focus
result_not_leaf: This does not look like a coffee leaf
result_not_leaf_hint: Please retake the photo following the tips above and try again.
demo_mode_banner: Demo mode — models are not trained/deployed yet. This result is a placeholder to preview the app.
low_confidence_banner: Low-confidence result — treat as preliminary. See "When to consult an expert" below.
history_empty: No scans yet. Diagnose a leaf and it will appear here.
library_subtitle: Browse full expert reference reports without scanning a photo.
about_body: Coffee Doctor uses a two-stage deep learning pipeline — a coffee-leaf detector followed by a disease classifier trained on Ethiopian coffee leaf imagery — to identify Coffee Leaf Rust, Cercospora Leaf Spot, and Phoma Leaf Blight, or confirm a healthy leaf. Reports are written for a farmer audience in four languages. This tool supports, but does not replace, your local agricultural extension officer.
about_privacy: Photos are analyzed to produce your report and are not stored on the server after processing.
offline_banner: You're offline. Connect to the internet to analyze a new leaf.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error_network: Couldn't reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
error_file_type: Please upload a JPEG, PNG, or WEBP photo.
